_note: Written by npm run precompute; do not edit. Planned planting for Around 2050 and Around 2100. First wave in 2050 (trees, shrubs, meadow, ponds); second wave of trees in 2075 (waves: counts and spacing along the green bands). plants: one column per field, the same index is the same plant, sorted by planting year. x_dm, y_dm: position in decimetres from the kit centre (east, north). kind: index into kinds. Plant species are not decided here. A plant counts once it is older than maturity_years for its kind. clearings: open meadow clearings kept free of planned trees. meadow: strips along the green bands, drawn hatched; rings are outlines as flat lists x, y, x, y, … in decimetres.
